walkthroughs.body_html:
Introduction to Business Management — a core area of Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Introduction to Business Management brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Introduction to Business Management.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How does HRM differ from traditional personnel management?
options: HRM and personnel are exactly the same thing — just a name change.
HRM treats people as a strategic asset and integrates human resource policies with business strategy; personnel management is more administrative and reactive, handling hiring, pay and disputes.

HRM only applies to large multinational companies.
